slots.root: fixed z-sheet flex flex-col bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-neutral shadow-surface-deep overflow-hidden
slots.head: flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-4 border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300
slots.trigger: flex flex-1 items-center gap-2 bg-transparent border-none p-0 cursor-pointer text-left font-display font-extrabold text-h3 text-base-content tracking-tight transition-[color] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-out hover:text-base-content/82 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary
slots.close: inline-flex items-center shrink-0 bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer text-base-content/62 text-[length:var(--icon-md)] leading-ctl transition-[color] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-out hover:text-base-content focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary
slots.body: flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4 font-body text-md leading-body text-base-content/82
slots.foot: flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2.5 px-5 py-4 border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-base-300

bottom.root: start-0 end-0 bottom-0 max-h-[80vh] rounded-t-lg pb-[var(--pad-safe-bottom)]

start.root: inset-y-0 start-0 w-120 max-w-[92vw] rounded-e-lg pt-[var(--pad-safe-top)] pb-[var(--pad-safe-bottom)]

end.root: inset-y-0 end-0 w-120 max-w-[92vw] rounded-s-lg pt-[var(--pad-safe-top)] pb-[var(--pad-safe-bottom)]
